deviations.actual: Used AddCertificate(cert) (singular) and CollectionUtilities.CreateStore<T>() API instead. CollectionStore<> is not a public type in BC 2.5.0.
deviations.reason: BouncyCastle 2.5.0 removed CollectionStore<> as a public type. IStore<T> is created via CollectionUtilities.CreateStore<T>(). The AddCertificate() singular method works equally well.
AttributeTable constructor takes IDictionary<DerObjectIdentifier, object> in BC 2.5.0, not Hashtable.

deviations.planned: Use outerSd.SignedContent.GetContent() to get inner bytes
deviations.reason: CmsProcessable interface in BC 2.5.0 only has Write(Stream) method; GetContent() does not exist.

deviations.planned: Add tests including existing theory test for adcs/ejbca EST returning 410
deviations.actual: Updated existing theory test Est_Simpleenroll_ValidCsr_ReturnsIssued to separate selfsigned (200 OK) from adcs/ejbca (410 Gone). Added 9 new tests for SCEP and EJBCA REST endpoints.
deviations.reason: The original test had [InlineData(adcs)] and [InlineData(ejbca)] expecting 200, which now correctly return 410.

notes: The ADCS backend's IssueViaEst() method was kept (satisfying IHarnessBackend interface) but now returns a rejection with protocol-mismatch reason code. The EJBCA backend similarly keeps IssueViaEst() for interface compliance but returns a rejection. New IssueViaScep() and IssueViaRest() methods handle actual enrollment. TeamBackends already exposed Adcs and Ejbca properties so no changes to TeamBackendRegistry were needed.
